newsitem.title: CANADA: Sterling to buy CanOxy Romania oil interest.
newsitem.headline: Sterling to buy CanOxy Romania oil interest.

text.p: Sterling Resources Ltd said on Monday it agreed to purchase Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd's 10 percent stake in two exploration licenses in the Romanian Black Sea.

Sterling, formerly Peoples Oil, said closing of the deal was conditional on approvals from project participants and government agencies, as well as some adjustments to the exploration and production agreement.
The company said the exploration program called for three wells in 1997, the first of which was being drilled.
If Sterling completed the acquisition, it would be responsible for 10 percent of the program's US$15.3 million costs, it said.
